conflicts.summary: KIWASCO revenue collection efficiency for FY 2024/25: WASREB IMPACT 18 prints 100%, the company website says 98% (average), and the tariff proposal prints 105% in its cost table and 102% in its target table.
conflicts.hypothesis: Different definitions: WASREB caps or rounds the KPI (collections over billing, possibly capped at 100), the tariff table counts collections of arrears against the year's billing (above 100%), and the website gives a monthly average. Not averaged; the regulator's figure is not preferred by rule. Needs each document's definition.

conflicts.summary: KIWASCO connections: IMPACT 18 prints 65,697 (FY 2024/25, all active); the company page says it "currently" has 50,053.
conflicts.hypothesis: The web page is older than FY 2024/25 (no date printed) or counts accounts rather than connections; IMPACT 18 printing total = active (65,697 both) also suggests a reporting simplification. Date the web text before closing.

conflicts.summary: Kisumu piped water: the Statistical Abstract prints 111,565 households connected in 2023 (all providers, county), WASREB IMPACT 18 prints 65,697 KIWASCO connections in FY 2024/25.
conflicts.hypothesis: Different units and scope: households versus metered connections (one connection can serve several households, e.g. plots and yard taps), all providers versus KIWASCO only, calendar 2023 versus FY 2024/25. Not a like-for-like comparison; neither figure is a county coverage rate.

conflicts.summary: Kisumu child immunisation 2022: administrative full-immunisation coverage of under-ones 89.70% (Statistical Abstract, county health department) against 79% of children aged 12-23 months with all basic antigens (KDHS 2022 survey).
conflicts.hypothesis: Different methods and age groups: administrative doses over an estimated target population (which the same table shows is too small in Kisumu Central, above 100%) against a household survey of children 12-23 months with card or recall. The survey is the population estimate; the administrative rate measures service output. Both kept.
